judged_text: ensure_embeddable now runs EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? — an uncached SQL query with no index on embeddable_hosts.host (the migration creates none, and the lower() wrapping defeats a plain btree) — on every /embed/comments request, and TopicRetriever#invalid_host? issues the same query per retrieval. Forums with many embedded pages pay a new DB roundtrip on every comment-widget view and every feed poll, with nothing to serve the lookup efficiently; DB slowdowns now degrade the hot public embed path where the previous check was a site-settings lookup, so operators of embed-heavy forums inherit fresh per-request DB load.

adjudication.rationale: The diff moves embed host checks from in-memory SiteSetting logic to DB-backed lookups: EmbedController#ensure_embeddable now calls EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer) and TopicRetriever#invalid_host? calls the same. EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? queries via record_for_host -> where("lower(host) = ?", host).first, and the migration creating embeddable_hosts does not add an index on host. This is a concrete, diff-grounded performance/architecture concern (extra DB roundtrips on hot paths), not a functional correctness bug proven by the diff.
